item.title: CVE-2026-109081 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.8
item.description: Friday 6 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.8 | A flaw was found in Keycloak. The Dynamic Client Registration (DCR) endpoint does not properly validate authorization when processing the deprecated defaultRoles field. An authenticated attacker with client creation privileges or an Initial Access Token (IAT) can inject excessive roles into the realm's default roles configuration. This causes clients across the realm to generate bloated access tokens, resulting in performance and memory degradation that can lead to a Denial of Service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2026-110525 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Friday 6 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The MCB WordPress plugin through 1.0.0 does not sanitise or escape request header values before storing them and later rendering them in the administrator statistics grid, allowing unauthenticated attackers to store malicious JavaScript that executes in an administrator's browser session when the statistics page is viewed.

item.title: CVE-2026-110532 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Friday 6 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Mail Mage WordPress plugin through 0.0.25 does not properly sanitise and escape a user-supplied value before using it in a SQL statement, allowing unauthenticated attackers to perform SQL injection attacks.

item.title: CVE-2026-110813 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Friday 6 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Advanced Custom Fields (ACF®) WordPress plugin before 6.8.11 does not properly sanitize a stored field definition that can be modified through its comment handling, allowing unauthenticated users to inject a payload that is emitted as an HTML attribute name and executed as JavaScript in the browser of any visitor or administrator who views a page rendering the affected field.

item.title: CVE-2026-110955 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Friday 6 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Wurdey WordPress plugin through 1.0.0 does not verify a request signature before logging a user in, allowing unauthenticated attackers to authenticate as an administrator knowing only the administrator's username.

item.title: CVE-2026-113584 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Friday 6 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The placester WordPress plugin through 1.4.3 does not perform any capability, nonce or ownership check on an AJAX action that updates account details, allowing unauthenticated attackers to overwrite any user's email address, including an administrator's, and take over the account through the standard password-reset flow.

item.title: CVE-2026-113615 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Friday 6 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The GS JWT Authentication for WP REST API WordPress plugin through 1.0.0 does not sanitize or parameterize a request value before using it in SQL queries on several unauthenticated REST routes, allowing unauthenticated attackers to perform SQL injection and obtain an administrator session.

item.title: CVE-2026-114427 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Friday 6 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The GutenKit WordPress plugin before 2.5.5 does not properly sanitize custom CSS saved against a post before printing it inside an inline style block on the published page, allowing users with the Author role and above to break out of the style element and store JavaScript that executes in the browser of any visitor who views the post. Exploitation affects sites running WordPress below 7.0.

item.title: CVE-2026-115230 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Friday 6 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The WHIZZ WordPress plugin through 1.1.8 does not validate the password-reset key before updating a user's password, relying only on a nonce that is exposed to unauthenticated visitors, allowing attackers to set an arbitrary password for any user, including administrators, and fully take over their accounts.

item.title: CVE-2026-115673 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Friday 6 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Anti-Spam, Spam FireWall by CleanTalk WordPress plugin before 6.91 does not escape a commenter-supplied value before outputting it on an administrative spam-review screen, allowing unauthenticated users to inject arbitrary web scripts that execute in the browser of an administrator who reviews flagged comments.

item.title: CVE-2026-116533 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Friday 6 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Static Snapshot WordPress plugin through 0.2.1 does not sanitise shell metacharacters in a user-supplied value before concatenating it into operating-system commands run by the server, allowing unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary commands on the host.

item.title: CVE-2026-118045 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Friday 6 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Ever Accounting WordPress plugin before 2.3.3 does not restrict the file path supplied to its CSV import routine to an allowed directory, allowing users with its custom Accounting Manager role (which does not have administrator privileges) to delete arbitrary files on the server, such as wp-config.php, which takes the entire site offline.

item.title: CVE-2026-118167 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Friday 6 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The MC4WP: Mailchimp for WordPress plugin before 4.15.0 does not validate that the Mailchimp audience a sign-up form or bundled integration subscribes a visitor to matches the audience configured by the site owner, allowing unauthenticated visitors to subscribe arbitrary email addresses to any other audience in the site's connected Mailchimp account.

item.title: CVE-2026-118186 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Friday 6 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The PublishPress Revisions: Duplicate Posts, Submit, Approve and Schedule Content Changes WordPress plugin before 4.3.1 does not correctly restrict who may publish content, allowing users such as Contributors who can edit but not publish to make unreviewed posts and pages publicly live, bypassing the intended editorial approval workflow.

item.title: CVE-2026-118187 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Friday 6 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The PublishPress Revisions: Duplicate Posts, Submit, Approve and Schedule Content Changes WordPress plugin before 4.3.1 does not verify that a user requesting to duplicate or revise a post has access to that specific post, only that they can edit posts of that type, allowing users with contributor-level access and above to duplicate another user's private, draft, pending or scheduled post into one they own and read its full content.

item.title: CVE-2026-118188 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Friday 6 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The PublishPress Revisions: Duplicate Posts, Submit, Approve and Schedule Content Changes WordPress plugin before 4.3.1 does not verify that a user is permitted to read a given post before returning its content through its revision-comparison feature, allowing any authenticated user, including a Subscriber, to read the title, content and excerpt of any other user's private, draft, pending, scheduled or trashed post.

item.title: CVE-2026-118239 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Friday 6 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The AutomatorWP WordPress plugin before 6.0.7 does not check that the user completing its Zoom and AWeber integration connections is allowed to do so, allowing unauthenticated attackers to replace the stored integration credentials with their own and divert the data the site sends to those services into an account they control. Exploitation requires the integration to already be connected and knowledge of the site's OAuth client identifier.

item.title: CVE-2026-118639 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Friday 6 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Surfer WordPress plugin before 1.8.1.759 discloses a sensitive API credential to low-privileged users through the post editor page and relies on that same credential as the sole authorization for its privileged REST API, allowing users with contributor-level access and above to read the credential and escalate to publishing arbitrary posts and other privileged actions.

item.title: CVE-2026-119259 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Friday 6 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The All-in-One Video Gallery WordPress plugin before 5.1.0 does not check the type, status or ownership of the target post before writing its view count and duration meta, allowing unauthenticated visitors to create or change that meta on any post, including private and draft posts, and to inflate the view count without limit.

item.title: CVE-2026-120408 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Friday 6 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The All-in-One Video Gallery WordPress plugin before 5.1.0 does not escape a video's stored thumbnail URL before outputting it in the admin video list, and does not sanitise that value when it is written outside its own editor, allowing users with a role as low as Subscriber to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks against administrators.

item.title: CVE-2026-121837 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 4.3
item.description: Friday 6 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 4.3 | A flaw was found in the REST Data Panache component of Quarkus. When a security constraint is applied to an entity property using the @SecureField annotation on its getter method rather than the field itself, the generated REST resource fails to enforce this constraint for filtering and sorting operations. This allows an authenticated user to infer sensitive data values by observing which records match specific filter criteria or how they are ordered, even though the values are omitted from the final response.

item.title: CVE-2026-123037 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.7
item.description: Friday 6 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.7 | A flaw was found in the ansible-core user module. When generate_ssh_key is enabled, User.ssh_key_gen() guards the key files against symlinks but checks the ~/.ssh directory only with os.path.exists(). An unprivileged user on a managed node who replaces their ~/.ssh with a symlink to an existing root-writable directory causes the privileged module to write the generated key pair through the symlink and then chown both files to that user. Because such files can be dropped into directories processed by schedulers (e.g. /etc/cron.daily) or dynamic MOTD (/etc/update-motd.d), the user can escalate to root on the managed node. This is an incomplete fix of CVE-2024-9902.

item.title: CVE-2026-12967 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Friday 6 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The WCFM Membership WordPress plugin before 2.12.1 does not verify that payment was made before completing a paid membership, allowing any authenticated Subscriber/Customer to activate a paid vendor membership for free and gain the marketplace vendor role.

item.title: CVE-2026-19688 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.8
item.description: Friday 6 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.8 | A flaw was found in the Admin REST API of Keycloak, an identity and access management solution. The Admin API fails to verify the intended audience of bearer tokens during authentication. This issue allows an attacker who operates a client within a realm to capture an administrator's access token and reuse it to perform unauthorized administrative actions, potentially leading to full realm compromise.

item.title: CVE-2026-86606 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Friday 6 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The iubenda | All-in-one Compliance for GDPR / CCPA Cookie Consent + more WordPress plugin before 3.13.7 does not properly escape content it re-emits through its bundled HTML parser, allowing unauthenticated users to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute in the session of any visitor viewing them, including logged in administrators.

item.title: CVE-2026-87784 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Friday 6 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Cool Media Filter WordPress plugin through 1.0.1 does not perform any capability or nonce check when updating the capabilities of a role, allowing any authenticated user, such as a subscriber, to grant their own role administrator capabilities and take over the site.

item.title: CVE-2026-92396 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Friday 6 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The ShopEngine Gutenberg WooCommerce Builder Blocks Addon WordPress plugin before 2.4.4 does not validate the user's capabilities or the ownership of the targeted post in one of its AJAX actions, and does not escape the stored value before outputting it in a JavaScript context, allowing users with a role as low as contributor to inject arbitrary scripts into any post that will run when a higher privileged user edits it.

item.title: CVE-2026-92856 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 4.9
item.description: Friday 6 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 4.9 | A flaw was found in the SAML brokering component of Keycloak, an identity and access management solution. The issue occurs when Keycloak acts as an intermediary between an upstream identity provider and downstream services. Keycloak fails to respect specific security instructions called ProxyRestrictions in the login messages it receives. This allows a user to log into downstream services even when the original identity provider explicitly forbade further sharing of the login session. As a result, users can bypass security boundaries intended to limit where their identity can be used.

item.title: CVE-2026-96447 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 4.2
item.description: Friday 6 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 4.2 | A flaw was found in the TokenManager component of Keycloak, an open-source identity and access management solution. The issue occurs during the validation of stateless access tokens when the original user ID no longer exists. Keycloak incorrectly falls back to using the username to identify the user without verifying if the identity matches the original token subject. This could allow an attacker with an old token to gain access to a newly created service account if it shares the same client ID as a previously deleted one.

item.title: CVE-2026-96460 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.4
item.description: Friday 6 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.4 | A flaw was found in the token exchange mechanism of Keycloak. When using Standard Token Exchange V2, the system issues new tokens with a fresh lifetime based on the requester clients configuration instead of limiting it to the original tokens expiration. This issue allows an authenticated requester to indefinitely extend access for service accounts by repeatedly exchanging tokens, even if the original client has been disabled by an administrator.

item.title: CVE-2026-96547 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5
item.description: Friday 6 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5 | A flaw was found in the Dynamic Client Registration component of Keycloak, an open-source identity and access management solution. The issue occurs because the system does not properly restrict which claim names can be used when setting up new clients. An attacker with valid registration credentials could create a client that incorrectly maps standard user profile information to sensitive security roles, potentially allowing them to gain unauthorized privileges on external applications that trust Keycloak tokens.

item.title: CVE-2026-97367 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.4
item.description: Friday 6 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.4 | A flaw was found in the Keycloak Account REST API where it incorrectly handles session identification. A malicious client owner can manipulate their own security tokens to point to a different user's active session. This allows the attacker to access and modify the victim's account information, potentially leading to a full account takeover by changing the recovery email and resetting the password.

item.title: CVE-2026-97848 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5
item.description: Friday 6 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5 | A flaw was found in the token sanitization logic of Keycloak, an open source identity and access management solution. The issue occurs when a protocol mapper is configured to emit structured claims using the JSON type. The security check designed to remove unauthorized role mappings only looks for standard Java maps and fails to recognize Jackson based JSON objects. This allows an attacker to inject forged client roles into security tokens, which could lead to unauthorized access to protected resources.

item.title: CVE-2026-120749 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.2
item.description: Friday 6 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.2 | A flaw was found in D-Bus. With a privileged Monitoring client attached (for example dbus-monitor or busctl monitor), an unprivileged local user can cause dbus-daemon to abort if a driver-originated broadcast such as NameOwnerChanged or ActivatableServicesChanged cannot be delivered to a recipient (for example due to a deny rule or an exceeded outgoing message queue). Driver broadcasts still use serial 0; when delivery fails, composing the monitor error reply asserts reply_serial != 0 and aborts the daemon. This is an incomplete fix for CVE-2023-34969, which only assigned serials for driver messages sent to a single recipient. On the well-known system bus this is a denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-73471 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.1
item.description: Friday 6 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.1 | A flaw was found in GStreamer gst-plugins-good (avidemux). In the Nikon metadata tag parser, a pointer can be dereferenced without verifying that data remains in the buffer, causing out-of-bounds reads. Because avidemux is auto-plugged by playbin, decodebin, and gst-discoverer, opening or previewing a crafted AVI is sufficient to trigger the issue. Fixed upstream in gst-plugins-good 1.28.6 (GStreamer-SA-2026-0072).

item.title: CVE-2026-73472 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.1
item.description: Friday 6 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.1 | A flaw was found in GStreamer gst-plugins-good (avidemux). In the superindex and subindex parsers, integer overflow can bypass bounds checks and cause out-of-bounds reads. Because avidemux is auto-plugged by playbin, decodebin, and gst-discoverer, opening or previewing a crafted AVI is sufficient to trigger the issue. Fixed upstream in gst-plugins-good 1.28.6 (GStreamer-SA-2026-0072).

item.title: CVE-2026-73473 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.5
item.description: Friday 6 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.5 | A flaw was found in GStreamer gst-plugins-good (avidemux). In the subindex parser, missing validation of the entry count can cause excessive memory allocation and denial of service. Because avidemux is auto-plugged by playbin, decodebin, and gst-discoverer, opening or previewing a crafted AVI is sufficient to trigger the issue. Fixed upstream in gst-plugins-good 1.28.6 (GStreamer-SA-2026-0072).

item.title: CVE-2026-83493 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Friday 6 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | A flaw was found in distributed-workloads. A remote attacker could exploit a vulnerability in the pull_request_target workflow by submitting a specially crafted pull request. This workflow processes untrusted code from the pull request author while operating with the base repository's sensitive secrets, such as the SNYK_TOKEN, and its default write token. Consequently, an attacker could exfiltrate these secrets, leading to unauthorized access to the Snyk integration and potential control over the repository.

item.title: CVE-2026-83494 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Friday 6 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | A flaw was found in the training-operator. An incorrect object casting in the PyTorchJob ValidateUpdate webhook allows users to bypass an immutability check. This vulnerability could enable users to detach a queued job from its quota management system or hijack a running job's controller ownership. The primary impact is a Denial of Service (DoS) condition.

item.title: CVE-2026-9797 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5
item.description: Friday 6 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5 | A flaw was found in Keycloak's administrative services (org.keycloak.services.resources.admin). A highly privileged attacker, authenticated with a 'manage-clients' role, could exploit this vulnerability through several methods, including manipulating client JSON Web Key Sets (JWKS), swapping client authenticator types and resetting secrets, or downloading legitimate signing keys. Successful exploitation allows the attacker to obtain a token with 'realm-admin' role assignments, leading to privilege escalation and potential unauthorized access to sensitive resources.
